assets/audio/en/stories/angry/p1.mp3.text: Ali and his little sister Elif are playing with a toy car.

assets/audio/en/stories/angry/p2.mp3.text: Elif took the car. Now Ali has nothing to play with.

assets/audio/en/stories/angry/p3.mp3.text: How do you think Ali feels now?

assets/audio/en/stories/angry/p3_happy.m.text: Take a look at Ali's face. Ali is angry.

assets/audio/en/stories/angry/p3_sad.mp3.text: Take a look at Ali's face. Ali is angry.

assets/audio/en/stories/angry/p4.mp3.text: Ali is really angry. He has a toy in his hand.

assets/audio/en/stories/angry/p5_throw.m.text: The toy fell on the floor. Elif is very sad.

assets/audio/en/stories/angry/p6.mp3.text: Ali said, "I'm angry!" He took a big, deep breath with Mom.

assets/audio/en/stories/angry/p7.mp3.text: Elif gave the car back. They took turns playing.

assets/audio/en/stories/angry/praise.mp3.text: Well done! You were a great help to Ali.

assets/audio/en/stories/doctor/p1.mp3.text: Today Ali is going to the doctor. Mom is with him.

assets/audio/en/stories/doctor/p2.mp3.text: They sit down in the waiting room. Ali feels a little scared.

assets/audio/en/stories/doctor/p3.mp3.text: What can Ali do when he feels scared?

assets/audio/en/stories/doctor/p3_run.mp.text: Ali ran to the door. Mom got very worried.

assets/audio/en/stories/doctor/p4.mp3.text: The doctor came in. She smiled and said, "Hello, Ali!"

assets/audio/en/stories/doctor/p5.mp3.text: The doctor wants to listen to his heart. What should Ali do?

assets/audio/en/stories/doctor/p5_push.m.text: The doctor couldn't hear his heart. Let's sit still for a moment.

assets/audio/en/stories/doctor/p6.mp3.text: The checkup is over! How does Ali feel now?

assets/audio/en/stories/doctor/p6_scared.text: Look, Ali is smiling. He isn't scared anymore.

assets/audio/en/stories/doctor/p7.mp3.text: The doctor gave Ali a star sticker. You were so brave, Ali!

assets/audio/en/stories/doctor/praise.mp.text: Well done! You were a great help to Ali.

assets/audio/en/stories/teeth/p2.mp3.text: Ali went to the bathroom and picked up his toothbrush.

assets/audio/en/stories/teeth/p3.mp3.text: The toothpaste is on the brush. What do we do now?

assets/audio/en/stories/teeth/p3_bed.mp3.text: Let's brush our teeth first, then we go to bed.

assets/audio/en/stories/teeth/p4.mp3.text: Ali brushes his teeth nice and slow. Up and down.

assets/audio/en/stories/teeth/p5.mp3.text: All done brushing. What comes next?

assets/audio/en/stories/teeth/p5_shoes.m.text: First, let's rinse our mouth with water.

assets/audio/en/stories/teeth/p6.mp3.text: His teeth are sparkling clean! How does Ali feel?

assets/audio/en/stories/teeth/p6_sad.mp3.text: Look, Ali is smiling. Ali is very happy.

assets/audio/en/stories/teeth/p7.mp3.text: Ali climbed into bed. Good night, Ali!

assets/audio/en/stories/teeth/praise.mp3.text: Well done! You were a great help to Ali.

assets/audio/en/stories/turn/p1.mp3.text: Ali is at the park. Look at that slide!

assets/audio/en/stories/turn/p2.mp3.text: Elif is on the slide ladder. It's her turn now.

assets/audio/en/stories/turn/p3.mp3.text: Ali wants to slide too. What should he do?

assets/audio/en/stories/turn/p3_cut.mp3.text: Ali cut in front of Elif. Elif is very sad.

assets/audio/en/stories/turn/p4.mp3.text: Ali waits for his turn. One, two, three...

assets/audio/en/stories/turn/p5.mp3.text: Elif went down the slide. Whose turn is it now?

assets/audio/en/stories/turn/p5_elif_aga.text: Elif had her turn. Now it's Ali's turn!

assets/audio/en/stories/turn/p6.mp3.text: Ali went down the slide! How does Ali feel?

assets/audio/en/stories/turn/p6_angry.mp.text: Look, Ali is laughing. Ali is very happy.

assets/audio/en/stories/turn/p7.mp3.text: Taking turns is so much fun!

assets/audio/en/stories/turn/praise.mp3.text: Well done! You learned how to wait for your turn.

assets/audio/tr/stories/angry/p1.mp3.text: Ali ile kardeşi Elif arabayla oynuyorlar.

assets/audio/tr/stories/angry/p2.mp3.text: Elif arabayı aldı. Ali'nin elinde araba kalmadı.

assets/audio/tr/stories/angry/p3_happy.m.text: Ali'nin yüzüne bir bak. Ali kızdı.

assets/audio/tr/stories/angry/p3_sad.mp3.text: Ali'nin yüzüne bir bak. Ali kızdı.

assets/audio/tr/stories/angry/p4.mp3.text: Ali çok kızdı. Elinde de bir oyuncak var.

assets/audio/tr/stories/angry/p5_throw.m.text: Oyuncak yere düştü. Elif çok üzüldü.

assets/audio/tr/stories/angry/p6.mp3.text: Ali, "Ben kızdım!" dedi. Annesiyle birlikte derin bir nefes aldı.

assets/audio/tr/stories/angry/p7.mp3.text: Elif arabayı geri verdi. Sırayla oynadılar.

assets/audio/tr/stories/angry/praise.mp3.text: Aferin sana! Ali'ye çok güzel yardım ettin.

assets/audio/tr/stories/doctor/p1.mp3.text: Bugün Ali doktora gidiyor. Annesi de yanında.

assets/audio/tr/stories/doctor/p2.mp3.text: Bekleme odasına oturdular. Ali biraz korkuyor.

assets/audio/tr/stories/doctor/p3_run.mp.text: Ali kapıya koştu. Annesi çok telaşlandı.

assets/audio/tr/stories/doctor/p5.mp3.text: Doktor kalbini dinleyecek. Ali ne yapsın?

assets/audio/tr/stories/doctor/p5_push.m.text: Doktor kalbini dinleyemedi. Haydi, biraz sakin duralım.

assets/audio/tr/stories/doctor/p6.mp3.text: Muayene bitti! Ali şimdi nasıl hissediyor?

assets/audio/tr/stories/doctor/p7.mp3.text: Doktor Ali'ye bir yıldız verdi. Çok cesurdun Ali!

assets/audio/tr/stories/doctor/praise.mp.text: Aferin sana! Ali'ye çok güzel yardım ettin.

assets/audio/tr/stories/teeth/p2.mp3.text: Ali banyoya gitti, diş fırçasını aldı.

assets/audio/tr/stories/teeth/p3.mp3.text: Fırçaya macunu sürdük. Şimdi ne yapacağız?

assets/audio/tr/stories/teeth/p4.mp3.text: Ali dişlerini yavaş yavaş fırçalıyor. Aşağı, yukarı.

assets/audio/tr/stories/teeth/p6.mp3.text: Dişleri pırıl pırıl oldu! Ali nasıl hissediyor?

assets/audio/tr/stories/teeth/p6_sad.mp3.text: Bak, Ali gülümsüyor. Ali çok mutlu.

assets/audio/tr/stories/teeth/p7.mp3.text: Ali yatağına girdi. İyi geceler Ali!

assets/audio/tr/stories/teeth/praise.mp3.text: Aferin sana! Ali'ye çok güzel yardım ettin.

assets/audio/tr/stories/turn/p1.mp3.text: Ali parka geldi. Kaydırak ne kadar güzel!

assets/audio/tr/stories/turn/p2.mp3.text: Elif kaydırağın merdiveninde. Şimdi o kayacak.

assets/audio/tr/stories/turn/p3.mp3.text: Ali de kaymak istiyor. Ne yapsın?

assets/audio/tr/stories/turn/p3_cut.mp3.text: Ali, Elif'in önüne geçti. Elif çok üzüldü.

assets/audio/tr/stories/turn/p4.mp3.text: Ali sırasını bekliyor. Bir, iki, üç...

assets/audio/tr/stories/turn/p6_angry.mp.text: Bak, Ali gülüyor. Ali çok mutlu.
